focus: deepseek-04: Context-reduction seams and their deadlines

label: Advisor chain budget: settings 3000ms -> shim child kill 2500ms SIGKILL -> internal 2200ms (2500-300 margin); every child failure returns {} and the prompt proceeds without a brief
PreCompact internal HOOK_TIMEOUT_MS=1800 under a 3s hook; deadline-driven remainingMs; optional snapshot skipped below floor and spawned with timeout=remaining; merge logs elapsed vs budget
Routing seams are CLIs, not hooks: compiled-route prints a decision or the legacy sentinel; lookup-trigger-index is a cold-Node synchronous lookup with 20-candidate default; tool-call budget only
PostToolUse exists with 10s Write|Edit matcher and 5s Bash matcher; neither rewrites tool output, so the pruning seam is capability-blocked not deadline-blocked
Two call paths: Node-native connect+call (no spawn) for hooks vs shell-out spawn+call for scripts; headroom uses per-path measured p95, not a spawn-included number

Rows 1 and 5 partial flip: deadline half removed for a Node-native Deem call (2200ms vs ~80ms), evidence gate (R1 keep + measured p95) stays; PreCompact command hook not flipped without merge duration and batch count
Row 38 (Bash output filter) rests on capability and redaction, not deadline; row 40 (advisor cache) confirmed dropped for a new reason: a cheap local call makes the cache less valuable

Degrade path per seam: advisor {} fail-open; PreCompact skip step and merge proceeds; routing legacy sentinel; scripts skip line; update restart window is the cold case and hooks must skip, never retry
Probe runs once per run/session, cached in-process only; a server stopped mid-session makes the next call refused/unmeasured and the following probe skips; no file cache, no default
Gate restated: allowlist backend torch|ensemble:* (no stub) + model pin deem-0.8-v1; deem-ctl is the tested reference; probe timeout must fit 2200/1800ms budgets
